params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-runner-v2-supported-install'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $tmp){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force}; git clone --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $tmp; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('git clone failed: '+$LASTEXITCODE)}; $script=Join-Path $tmp 'heaven-bridge\install-github-runner.ps1'; $dir=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'actions-runner-heaven-v2-supported'; & $script -RunnerName 'heaven-v2' -RunnerDirectory $dir -Labels @('heaven-v2','local-bridge','mhw-mods'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('runner installer failed: '+$LASTEXITCODE)}; Write-Output 'HEAVEN_V2_SUPPORTED_INSTALL_OK'
